record.bible_text: When Israel<WH03478> <FI>was<Fi> a child<WH05288>, then I loved<WH0157><WTH8799> him, and called<WH07121><WTH8804> my son<WH01121> out of Egypt<WH04714>.

They shall walk<WH03212><WTH8799> after<WH0310> the LORD<WH03068>: he shall roar<WH07580><WTH8799> like a lion<WH0738>: when he shall roar<WH07580><WTH8799>, then the children<WH01121> shall tremble<WH02729><WTH8799> from the west<WH03220>.
